meta.title: ExpressHub - Every delivery connected
meta.description: Book, follow, and manage your courier deliveries with ExpressHub.

shell.sidebarNote: Every delivery starts with a connection.
shell.footerTagline: From your doorstep to theirs. Modern express delivery platform.

home.signedInText: Signed in as an active {role}. Jump straight into your workspace to book parcels, track live milestone transitions, or monitor logistics telemetry.
home.intro: A simpler, modern way to move what matters. Bring your bookings, real-time tracking, Stripe-verified payments, and courier operations together in one unified platform.
home.heroImageAlt: ExpressHub courier holding a package and clipboard
home.rolesTitle: A purpose built workspace for every role.
home.customerText: Get weight-based shipping quotes, book doorstep pickups, complete instant Stripe checkout, and follow chronological event timelines.
home.customerImageAlt: 3D illustration of customer booking parcel on mobile device
home.courierText: Access assigned delivery batches, execute status progressions from pickup to proof of delivery, and submit mandatory transit notes.
home.courierImageAlt: 3D illustration of express courier van in transit
home.adminText: Assign couriers with optimistic concurrency protection, monitor fleet telemetry, manage user access, and inspect immutable audit logs.
home.adminImageAlt: 3D illustration of logistics operations analytics command center
home.continueTitle: Ready to continue your logistics operations?
home.continueText: Your account is active. Jump directly into your dedicated workspace to book deliveries, execute milestone status progressions, or update your profile.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to experience frictionless parcel logistics?
home.ctaText: Create an account in seconds. Book your first parcel, test the milestone delivery lifecycle, and track updates in real time with enterprise-grade security.

developer.keysIntro: Use a key from your own server to book and track shipments. Send it as Authorization: Bearer {token}. Never put a key in a browser or mobile app.
developer.keysUsed: {count, number} of {max, number} active keys used
developer.guideWrite: shipments:write: book shipments and cancel ones that have not been picked up.
developer.guideManage: webhooks:manage: add, change and test webhook endpoints. Keys can never create or revoke other keys.
developer.guideVerify: Each request has <signature></signature>, an HMAC-SHA256 of <body></body> with your signing secret. Use <event></event> to ignore duplicates, and reply with any 2xx status within 5 seconds.
